# Delta Cosmology

> RDelta preformalism, Babel Index telemetry, and NEOTH runtime tests for detecting loss of productive difference in complex agentic systems.

## Claim Boundary

Delta Cosmology is a preformal framework and structured hypothesis set. The Babel Index is an empirical feature family. A successful NEOTH pilot validates only the local LLM/agent telemetry instrument unless independent domain evidence supports broader claims.
